Aim.description: What a particle's direction is measured from.

oneOf.description: `direction`, the same for every particle.
Away from the emitter's centre, so a circle or burst sprays outwards.
Towards the emitter's centre.

Each particle travels from where it is born to the emitter's centre over its life,
easing in and out, so sparks gather into one point; speed, direction, gravity, wind
and drag do not apply.
Left aligned.
Centred.
Right aligned.

Animation.description: One of a clip's animations: a preset and how long it takes.

delay.description:
How long it waits (0 when omitted): an entrance starts this long after the clip's
start and holds its first state until then, an exit ends this long before the
clip's end and holds its last state after, and a combo starts its cycles this late.
Staggered animations give each clip a growing delay.

duration.description: How long it takes; combo animations repeat with this period.

Animator.description: A caption animator (ADR-0021 item 3): its type, version, switch and parameters.

oneOf.description: The page fades in and out.

enabled.description: Whether it is applied; on when omitted.

oneOf.description: The page scales in.

enabled.description: Whether it is applied; on when omitted.

oneOf.description: Each word appears when it is spoken.

enabled.description: Whether it is applied; on when omitted.

oneOf.description: The spoken word changes colour, gains a box or grows.

enabled.description: Whether it is applied; on when omitted.

oneOf.description: Each word pops up and back as it is spoken.

enabled.description: Whether it is applied; on when omitted.

oneOf.description: Each word fills from left to right while it is spoken.

enabled.description: Whether it is applied; on when omitted.

oneOf.description: Words marked `emphasis` stand out.

enabled.description: Whether it is applied; on when omitted.

AssetRef.description: A reference to a media asset, such as a LUT file.

BlendMode.description:
How a clip's picture combines with the layers below it. Every mode except `normal`
works on display-encoded (sRGB) values, as designers expect, and then mixes by the
clip's opacity (ADR-0011, item 4).

oneOf.description: Covers what is below.
Darkens: below times the picture.
Lightens: the inverse of multiplying the inverses.
Multiply in the shadows of what is below and screen in its highlights.
The darker of the two, per channel.
The lighter of the two, per channel.
Brightens what is below to reflect the picture.
Darkens what is below to reflect the picture.
Overlay with the roles swapped: the picture decides multiply or screen.
A gentler hard light.
Sum minus one: darkens more than multiply.
Sum (linear dodge), clipped at white.
Absolute difference.
Like difference with lower contrast.

BrushStroke.description: One painted stroke of a brush mask.

points.description: The stroke's path in the picture, 0 to 1 from its top-left corner.

radius.description: The brush's radius as a fraction of the picture's height.

Burst.description: Many particles born at one moment.

CanvasFill.description: What fills the canvas around a clip's picture (CapCut parity CC-063).

oneOf.description: A solid colour.
The clip's own picture, scaled to cover the canvas and blurred.

amount.description: The blur radius as a fraction of the covering picture's height, from 0 to 0.2.

CaptionContent.description: One caption page: what is on screen at once.

translation.description:
The page in a second language, shown under it in the track's translation style
(bilingual captions); the agent or person writes it, FossCut never translates.

CaptionLine.description: One line of a caption page.

CaptionStyle.description: How a caption track's captions look and move; every field has a default.

animators.description: Animation, evaluated per frame from word times.

box.description: Background box behind each line (off when omitted).

font.description: Font family; the bundled sans-serif when omitted.

placement.description: Where the page sits inside the safe area (bottom when omitted).

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the canvas height (0.055 when omitted).

stroke.description: Outline around the letters (black, on, when omitted).

end.description: When it ends, from the clip's start.

start.description: When it is spoken, from the clip's start.

text.description: The word as shown, with attached punctuation.

ChannelMode.description: Which channels of a clip's sound play where (fill channel).

oneOf.description: As recorded.
The left channel fills both.
The right channel fills both.
Both channels mixed to one, played on both.

Clip.description: A clip on a track. The content kind decides which fields apply.

oneOf.description: A section of a video asset.

source_in.description: Source position of the clip's first frame.

oneOf.description: A section of an audio asset (or the audio of a video asset).

source_in.description: Source position of the clip's first sample.

oneOf.description: A still image held for the clip duration.
A text title.

reveal.description: How the text appears at the clip's start (and leaves at its end).

spans.description:
Parts of the text styled differently, by character positions; later spans win where
they overlap.

oneOf.description: A caption page: lines of timed words (ADR-0021).
An adjustment layer: its effects apply to everything below it while it lasts.
A drawn shape, background or sticker (ADR-0028).

closed.description:
False leaves a `path` shape open: a line from its first point to its last, not
joined back (ADR-0036). Closed when omitted.

contours.description:
More contours of a `path` shape after `points`, in the same box: holes, and parts
drawn and trimmed with it, as the subpaths of SVG path data.

fill.description:
What fills it: `null` for no fill, as lines have (white when omitted). An open
path's fill closes it with a straight edge.

fill_rule.description:
Which areas of overlapping contours are filled: `even_odd` (the default) or
`nonzero`, as in SVG.

label.description: Text on it, styled as a text clip's.

label_at.description:
Where the label's centre sits in the shape's box, -1 to 1 on each axis; the middle
when omitted.

points.description: The points of a `path` shape, -1 to 1 across the shape's box.

roundness.description: Corner rounding of a rectangle, from 0 (square) to 1 (fully round ends).

size.description: Width and height as fractions of the canvas's; `[1, 1]` covers it.

stroke.description: A stroke centred on its edge, or along an open path (ADR-0036).

trim_end.description:
Where the visible part ends, 0 to 1 of the length (1 when omitted); animating it
from 0 to 1 draws the outline on. Animate `shape.trim_end`.

trim_offset.description:
Moves the visible part along the outline by this fraction of its length, wrapping
around: 0.5 starts it halfway. Animate `shape.trim_offset`.

trim_start.description:
Where the visible part of the outline starts, 0 to 1 of its length (ADR-0036):
trims cut the stroke, and the fill of an open path. Animate `shape.trim_start`.

oneOf.description:
A compound clip: another timeline of the project, shown from `source_in`
(ADR-0025).

source_in.description: Where in that timeline the clip starts.

oneOf.description:
A camera (ADR-0037): while it covers a time on a video track, the timeline's 3D
clips are seen through it. It draws and sounds nothing itself.

aperture.description:
The lens opening of the depth of field, as a fraction of the canvas width, from 0
to 1 (0.1 when omitted): larger blurs layers away from the focus more.

depth_of_field.description: Blurs 3D layers by their distance from the plane in focus.

field_of_view.description:
The angle of view across the canvas width, in degrees from 1 to 170 (40 when
omitted). The camera keeps its framing distance (see `position_z`), so a wider
angle strengthens the perspective without changing what the z = 0 plane shows.

focus_offset.description:
How far the plane in focus lies beyond the point of interest along the view, as a
fraction of the canvas width; 0 focuses on the point of interest, negative nearer
the camera.

max_blur.description:
The largest blur radius of the depth of field, as a fraction of the canvas width,
from 0 to 0.2 (0.02 when omitted).

orbit.description:
Turns the camera around its point of interest, in degrees: `[yaw, pitch]`, where a
positive yaw moves the camera to the right and a positive pitch moves it up. It
keeps looking at the point of interest.

point_of_interest.description:
The point the camera looks at, as fractions of the canvas width and height from its
centre.

point_of_interest_z.description:
The depth of the point of interest, as a fraction of the canvas width; positive is
away from the viewer.

position.description:
Where the camera is across the canvas, as fractions of its width and height from
its centre; y grows downwards.

position_z.description:
How far the camera has moved forward from its framing distance (where the z = 0
plane exactly fills the frame), as a fraction of the canvas width: positive pushes
in (a dolly in), negative pulls back.

roll.description: Turns the view around its axis, in degrees; positive turns the picture clockwise.

oneOf.description:
A particle emitter (ADR-0038): sparks, embers, dust, snow, confetti and the like,
drawn over the whole canvas.

particles.description:
The emitter, under a key of its own so its settings never meet the clip's
fields (`speed`, `opacity`, `blend`).

oneOf.description:
A 3D object (ADR-0040): a glTF model or a built-in solid, lit and shaded, seen
through the timeline's camera and ordered among its 3D layers by depth.

model.description:
The object, under a key of its own so its settings never meet the clip's
fields (`opacity`).

angle.description:
A compound clip's angle: the one track of its timeline whose picture shows, for
multicam editing (ADR-0029); every track shows when omitted.

animations.description: How the clip moves in, out and while it shows.

audio.description: Fades, pan and channels of the clip's sound; unchanged when omitted.

blend.description: How the picture combines with the layers below it (normal when omitted).

canvas.description:
What fills the canvas around a video or image clip where its picture does not cover
it: a colour, or the clip's own picture scaled to cover and blurred. Black (or the
tracks below) shows when omitted.

crop.description: Edges of the picture removed; nothing when omitted.

effects.description:
Effects on the clip's picture, applied in order before placement. On an adjustment
clip they apply to everything below it.

enabled.description: False deactivates the clip: it keeps its place but is neither drawn nor heard.

follow.description:
The shape clip whose path this clip moves along, with how far along it is
(ADR-0036); it stays where its transform puts it when omitted.

group.description: The group of clips this one edits together with (`group_…`, ADR-0024).

keyframes.description:
Keyframes by property path (`transform.position`, `opacity`, ...), each list sorted
by time with at most one keyframe per time. A property with keyframes takes its
value from them, not from its field.

masks.description:
Masks that decide which parts of the picture show, combined in order; on an
adjustment clip, where its effects apply.

speed.description:
How a video or audio clip plays its source: faster, slower, along a curve,
backwards or frozen (ADR-0023). Absent, it plays one to one.

start.description: Timeline position of the first frame.

transform.description: Placement on the canvas; identity when omitted.

transition.description:
The transition into the next clip on the track, played over the cut when the next
clip starts where this one ends.

volume.description: Linear audio gain (1 is unchanged, 0 is silent).

ClipAnimations.description: How a clip moves in, out and while it shows.

combo.description: Repeats for as long as the clip shows.

out.description: Plays up to the clip's end.

ClipAudio.description: How a clip's sound is shaped: fades, pan and channels.

detached.description:
A video clip's sound plays from an audio clip extracted from it, so the video clip
itself is not heard (ADR-0024).

fade_in.description: Fade in from silence over this long at the clip's start.

fade_out.description: Fade out to silence over this long at the clip's end.

pan.description: Stereo balance: -1 left, 0 centre (both sides unchanged), 1 right.

ColorBy.description: How a particle's colour is chosen.

oneOf.description: Through the colours from birth to death.
One of the colours at random, kept for life.

Contour.description: One more contour of a path shape.

closed.description: False leaves it open (closed when omitted).

points.description: Its points, -1 to 1 across the shape's box.

Crop.description:
Edges removed from a clip's picture, as fractions of its width and height before any
flip. What remains keeps its size and place on the canvas.

bottom.description: Fraction of the height removed at the bottom.

left.description: Fraction of the width removed on the left.

right.description: Fraction of the width removed on the right.

top.description: Fraction of the height removed at the top.

enabled.description: False bypasses the effect without removing it.

keyframes.description:
Keyframes of numeric parameters by parameter name, each sorted by time from the
clip's start. A parameter with keyframes takes its value from them.

params.description: Parameters that differ from their defaults.

version.description: Version of the type's parameters this instance was written with.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation of the shape in degrees.

edge.description: Born along the outline of a circle or rectangle instead of inside it.

position.description:
Its centre, as an offset from the canvas centre in fractions of the canvas width and
height like `transform.position`; y grows downwards (animatable as
`particles.emitter.position`, which moves where new particles are born).

size.description: Width and height as fractions of the canvas's, 0 to 4; a line runs along its width.

EmitterShape.description: The shape particles are born in. Emitting along a shape clip's path is left for later.

oneOf.description: One point.
A line as long as the emitter's width.
An ellipse of the emitter's size.
A rectangle of the emitter's size.

Faces.description:
Materials of single faces: of a box, of each block of a grid, or the front and back of
extruded text and paths. Faces are named as the viewer sees them at rest: `front` faces
the viewer, `top` faces up.

back.description: The face away from the viewer.

FillRule.description: Which areas of overlapping contours a fill covers.

oneOf.description: Inside an odd number of contours: a contour inside another cuts a hole.

Where the contours wind around a point at all, counted by direction: a contour
inside another cuts a hole only when it runs the other way.

Flicks.description: Time in flicks: 1/705,600,000 of a second (ADR-0005). 30 fps frames are 23,520,000 flicks long.

Floor.description: A level floor under an object.

catcher.description:
True (the default) shows only the shadow it catches, so the object can stand on a
photo or video below it; false draws the floor in `color`.

color.description: The colour of a drawn floor (`#9A9A9A` when omitted).

gap.description:
How far below the object's lowest point at rest the floor lies, -1 to 1; negative
sinks the object into it.

shadow.description:
How dark the shadow on a catcher is, 0 to 1 (0.6 when omitted; animate
`model.shadow`).

size.description: The floor's width and depth, 0.01 to 20 (4 when omitted).

Follow.description: A clip that moves along the path of a shape clip (ADR-0036).

clip.description: The shape clip whose outline it follows (`clip_…`), on the same timeline.

offset.description: Added to the point on the path, as fractions of the canvas width and height.

orient.description:
Turns the clip with the path's direction, added to its own rotation: 0 degrees
runs left to right.

progress.description:
How far along the path, as a fraction of its whole length: 0 at its start, 1 at its
end. On a closed path values past 1 go round again; on an open path they hold at
the ends. Animate `follow.progress`.

FontWeight.description: Font weights of the bundled fonts.

oneOf.description: Regular (400).
Bold (700).
Extra bold (800).
Black (900).

color.description: Its colour; its alpha sets the strength (white when omitted).

radius.description: How far it reaches in em, from 0 to 2 (0.3 when omitted).

angle.description: Its direction in degrees: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom.

radial.description: From the centre outwards instead of along a line.

Id.description: Stable object id: kind prefix and lowercase Crockford base32, for example clip_0007 or track_000a.

Interpolate.description: How frames between source frames are made.

oneOf.description: The source frame displayed at that time.

The two nearest source frames mixed by the position between them: smooth slow
motion.

The two nearest source frames warped along the optical flow between them toward
the position, then mixed, with what one of them hides taken from the other: smooth
slow motion in which moving things stay sharp instead of showing twice (ADR-0035).

Interpolation.description: How a value travels from one keyframe to the next.

oneOf.description: Keeps this keyframe's value until the next keyframe.
Changes at a constant rate.

Follows the cubic Bezier easing curve from (0, 0) to (1, 1) with control points
`[x1, y1, x2, y2]`, as in CSS: x is the fraction of the time between the keyframes
and y the fraction of the change. x1 and x2 are between 0 and 1.

anyOf.description: A number, such as a scale or an opacity.
A pair, such as a position `[x, y]`.

KeyValue.description: A keyframed value: a number, or a pair such as a position.

Keyframe.description: A property's value at one time.

interpolation.description: How the value moves from this keyframe to the next (linear when omitted).

time.description: Time from the clip's start; it may lie outside the clip after a trim.

Light.description:
The light on an object: a sky light from every direction, coloured from above and
below, and a key light from one direction that casts a soft shadow.

ambient.description:
How strong the sky light is, 0 to 4 (0.35 when omitted; animate
`model.light.ambient`).

azimuth.description:
Where the key light comes from around the vertical axis: 0 from the viewer's side,
90 from the right, -90 from the left, 180 from behind (-35 when omitted; animate
`model.light.azimuth`).

color.description: The key light's colour (white when omitted).

elevation.description:
How high the key light is above the horizon, -90 to 90 (50 when omitted; animate
`model.light.elevation`).

ground.description:
The sky light's colour from below, as light bounced off the ground (`#6B645C` when
omitted).

intensity.description:
How strong the key light is, 0 to 10: a white matte surface facing it shows this
much of its colour (1 when omitted; animate `model.light.intensity`).

shadows.description:
Whether the key light casts a shadow, on the object itself and on the floor (true
when omitted).

sky.description: The sky light's colour from above (white when omitted).

softness.description: How soft the shadow's edge is, 0 (sharp) to 1 (very soft); 0.35 when omitted.

LineCap.description: How a stroke ends at the ends of an open path and of dashes.

oneOf.description: Square, exactly at the end.
A half circle past the end.
Square, half the width past the end.

LineJoin.description: How a stroke turns at corners.

oneOf.description: A sharp point, cut off as a bevel past `miter_limit`.
Rounded.
Cut off flat.

Marker.description: A point on a timeline to come back to: a beat, a cue, a note.

color.description: Its color as `#RRGGBB`; the default marker color when omitted.

name.description: A label, such as `drop` or `cut here`.

center.description:
The middle of the mask in the picture, 0 to 1 from the top-left corner (the middle
when omitted).

enabled.description: False ignores the mask without removing it.

expansion.description:
Grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) the shape, -1 to 1, as a fraction of its
smaller half size.

feather.description: Softness of the edge, 0 (sharp) to 1, as a fraction of the mask's smaller half size.

invert.description: Keeps the outside instead of the inside.

keyframes.description:
Keyframes by property (`center`, `size`, `rotation`, `feather`, `expansion`,
`roundness`), times from the clip's start.

mode.description: How it combines with the masks before it.

roundness.description: Rounds a rectangle's corners, 0 (square) to 1 (fully round).

size.description: Width and height as fractions of the picture's (half of each when omitted).

MaskMode.description: How a mask combines with the masks before it.

oneOf.description: Shows what this mask covers as well.
Hides what this mask covers.
Shows only what this mask and the ones before cover.
A rectangle, with corners rounded by `roundness`.
An ellipse filling the mask's box.
Everything on one side of a line through the centre (above it, before rotation).
A band through the centre, `size` high: the mirror shape.
A five-pointed star.
A heart.
A closed path through `points`, straight or curved by their handles: the pen.
The letters of `text`, filling the mask's box.
Painted `strokes`.

Material.description: A simple physically based material (after the metallic-roughness model of glTF 2.0).

emissive.description: The colour of light it gives off by itself, as `#RRGGBB`; none when omitted.

emissive_strength.description:
How strongly it gives off that light, 0 to 100 (1 when omitted); above 1 it
outshines its surroundings and a `light.glow` effect blooms it.

metallic.description: 0 for paint, plastic, paper or wood, 1 for metal.

roughness.description: 0 for a mirror finish, 1 for a fully matte one (0.5 when omitted).

texture.description:
An image asset (`asset_…`) printed over the colour by its own transparency, so a
logo with a transparent background sits on the colour. On a box face it covers the
face; on other solids it wraps around them.

texture_size.description: How much of a face the texture covers, centred, 0.05 to 1 (1 when omitted).

emissive_strength.description:
Multiplies the light every material gives off by itself, 0 to 100 (1 when omitted;
animate `model.emissive_strength`).

faces.description:
Materials of single faces of a box or of every block of a grid, or of the front and
back of extruded text and paths (their sides and bevels keep `material`).

floor.description: A level floor under the object that catches its shadow, or shows as a surface.

light.description: The light on the object: a sky light and a key light with a shadow.

material.description:
Its material. A model asset keeps the materials of its file unless this is given;
built-in solids are light grey and half rough without it.

object.description: What the object is: a model asset or a built-in solid (a box when omitted).

oneOf.description: A glTF model asset (`.glb`, or `.gltf` with its files).

size.description:
The length of the model's longest side, 0.4 when omitted; the model is centred on
the middle of its bounds.

oneOf.description: A box, with rounded edges when bevelled; its faces take materials of their own.

bevel.description: The radius of its rounded edges, at most half its smallest side.

size.description: Width, height and depth (`[0.25, 0.25, 0.25]` when omitted).

oneOf.description: A sphere.
An upright cylinder with flat caps.

size.description: Its diameter and height (`[0.2, 0.3]` when omitted).

oneOf.description: A flat rectangle facing the viewer, like a picture; lay it down with `rotation_x`.

size.description: Its width and height (`[0.4, 0.4]` when omitted).

oneOf.description: A ring facing the viewer.

thickness.description: The diameter of its tube, less than half the outer diameter (0.08 when omitted).

oneOf.description: Text extruded into depth, with a bevel.

bevel.description: How far the letters' front and back edges are chamfered, at most half the depth.

depth.description: How deep the letters are, 0 to 1 (0.04 when omitted; animate `model.depth`).

font.description:
The font family: the bundled Inter or a project font asset's family (Inter when
omitted).

text.description: The text, 1 to 200 characters; `\n` starts a new line. Lines are centred.

oneOf.description: An outline from SVG path data (or a shape clip's path) extruded into depth.

bevel.description: How far its front and back edges are chamfered, at most half the depth.

depth.description: How deep it is, 0 to 1 (0.04 when omitted; animate `model.depth`).

path.description:
SVG path data (`M 0 0 L 10 0 ...`, y down); nested contours are holes, as with the
even-odd rule.

size.description:
The width of the outline's bounds; its height follows the outline (0.3 when
omitted).

oneOf.description: A grid of blocks of varied heights, standing on the ground like a city.

block.description: The width and depth of each block (0.05 when omitted).

fill.description: The share of lots that hold a block, 0 to 1 (1 when omitted).

gap.description: The street between blocks (0.015 when omitted).

growth.description:
How far the blocks have grown, 0 (flat) to 1 (full height); 1 when omitted
(animate `model.growth`).

heights.description:
The lowest and highest block, `[0.02, 0.2]` when omitted; heights are spread by the
square of a random number, so tall blocks are fewer.

rows.description: Blocks in depth, 1 to 64 (8 when omitted).

seed.description: Chooses the heights and empty lots; another seed gives another city.

Paint.description: A colour, or a gradient from it to a second colour.

color.description: The colour, where a gradient starts (white when omitted).

gradient.description: A gradient to a second colour.

anyOf.description: A pair such as a color wheel position `[x, y]`.
One of a fixed set of names.
Curve control points `[[x, y], ...]` from 0 to 1, sorted by x.

ParticleBlend.description:
How overlapping particles combine with each other (the clip's own blend mode decides
how the whole picture combines with what is below).

oneOf.description: Their light adds up, so crowds glow.
Later particles cover earlier ones.

aim.description: What the direction is measured from.

blend.description: How overlapping particles combine with each other.

bursts.description:
Moments when many particles are born at once, in emission time (from the clip's
start while `offset` is 0).

colors.description:
Colours: from birth to death, or to pick one from per particle (`color_by`); 1 to 8
(white when omitted).

direction.description:
Direction of travel at birth in degrees clockwise from rightwards: 90 is down, -90
up (animatable as `particles.direction`).

drag.description:
How quickly particles slow down, per second, 0 to 20: speed falls by e^(-drag) each
second, so with gravity they reach a steady speed.

gravity.description:
Downward acceleration in canvas heights per second squared; negative rises
(animatable as `particles.gravity`).

life.description: Seconds a particle lives, from 0.05 to 30 (2 when omitted).

life_variance.description: How much a particle's life varies either way, in seconds.

offset.description:
Where in its emission the clip starts. 0 for a new clip; splits and trims move it so
both parts continue the same particles.

opacity_over_life.description:
Opacity multipliers from birth to death, spread evenly over the life, 1 to 8 values
from 0 to 1 (`[1, 0]`, fading out, when omitted).

prewarm.description:
How long particles were already being born before emission time 0, so the clip
opens full instead of empty (at most 30 seconds).

rate.description: Particles born per second, 0 to 2000 (animatable as `particles.rate`).

rotation.description: Rotation at birth in degrees clockwise.

rotation_variance.description: How much the rotation varies either way, in degrees.

seed.description: Chooses the random choices: another seed gives other particles that look alike.

size.description: Diameter at birth in canvas heights, 0 to 2 (animatable as `particles.size`).

size_over_life.description:
Size multipliers from birth to death, spread evenly over the life, 1 to 8 values
from 0 to 10 (`[1]` keeps the size).

size_variance.description: How much the diameter varies either way.

speed.description: Speed at birth in canvas heights per second (animatable as `particles.speed`).

speed_variance.description: How much the speed varies either way.

spin.description: Turning speed in degrees per second, clockwise.

spin_variance.description: How much the turning speed varies either way.

spread.description:
Width of the cone of directions around `direction`, 0 to 360 degrees (animatable
as `particles.spread`).

turbulence.description:
How far turbulence pushes particles off their path, in canvas heights, 0 to 2
(animatable as `particles.turbulence`).

turbulence_scale.description: The size of turbulence's swirls in canvas heights, 0.01 to 10 (0.2 when omitted).

wind.description:
Rightward acceleration in canvas heights per second squared; negative blows left
(animatable as `particles.wind`).

PathPoint.description: A point of a path mask, with optional Bezier handles relative to it.

at.description: The point in the mask's box, -1 to 1.

in.description: The handle towards the previous point; a corner when omitted.

out.description: The handle towards the next point; a corner when omitted.

Pitch.description: What happens to the pitch of sound played at another speed.

oneOf.description: The sound keeps its pitch: it is time-stretched (WSOLA).
The sound is resampled, so its pitch follows the speed.

Placement.description: Where a caption page sits inside the canvas's safe area (ADR-0021 item 5).

oneOf.description: At the top of the safe area.
Centred.
At the bottom of the safe area.

Rate.description: Exact frame rate as an integer or a fraction string, for example "30" or "30000/1001" (29.97). Decimals are not accepted.

RevealEasing.description:
How a reveal unit's motion runs from 0 to 1 (Robert Penner's easing equations and CSS
cubic Bezier curves).

oneOf.description: Constant speed.
Starts slowly (cubic).
Slows to a stop (cubic): the default for most motions.
Starts and ends slowly (cubic).
Overshoots by about 10% and settles back.
Bounces against its end a few times.
Springs past its end and rings out.
A cubic Bezier `[x1, y1, x2, y2]` as in CSS; x1 and x2 from 0 to 1, y may overshoot.

RevealMotion.description: How each unit of a reveal appears.

oneOf.description: At once (a typewriter for letters).
Fading in.
Fading in while rising into place.
Fading in from a soft blur into focus.
Growing from nothing past full size and settling (`back` easing).
Shrinking from large into place while fading in.
Sliding in from the right towards the left while fading in.
Sliding in from the left towards the right while fading in.
Falling into place from above with a bounce (`bounce` easing).
Letters spread apart closing up to their spacing while fading in (tracking in).

RevealOrder.description: The order units of a reveal arrive in.

oneOf.description: First to last, as read.
Last to first.
From the middle outwards; units as far from the middle arrive together.
From both ends inwards.
A shuffled order, the same on every render.

RevealUnit.description: What a reveal shows at a time.

oneOf.description: One letter after another, as typed.
One word after another.
One line after another.

Shadow.description: A shadow cast by the letters (and their outline).

blur.description: How soft it is in em, from 0 (sharp) to 1 (0.08 when omitted).

offset.description:
How far it falls, right and down, in em, each from -1 to 1 ([0.06, 0.06] when
omitted).

ShapeOutline.description: An outline along a shape's edge, inside it.

width.description:
Its width as a fraction of the shape's shorter side, from 0 to 0.5 (0.04 when
omitted).

ShapeStroke.description: A stroke centred on a shape's edge or along an open path (ADR-0036).

cap.description: The ends of an open path and of dashes: `butt` (the default), `round` or `square`.

color.description: Its colour, where a gradient starts (white when omitted).

dash_offset.description: Where the dash pattern starts, as a fraction of the canvas height.

dashes.description:
Dash pattern: lengths of dashes and gaps in turn, as fractions of the canvas height;
solid when empty.

gradient.description: A gradient to a second colour across the shape's box, as a fill's.

miter_limit.description:
How far a miter may reach, in stroke widths, before it is cut off as a bevel; at
least 1 (4 when omitted).

width.description:
Its width as a fraction of the canvas height, from 0 to 0.5 (0.01 when omitted);
animate `shape.stroke_width`. The clip's scale scales it too.

Speed.description: How a clip plays its source: faster, slower, along a curve, backwards or frozen.

curve.description:
A speed curve: the rate changes linearly between points and holds before the first
and after the last.

interpolate.description:
Show the nearest source frame, or make one between the two around each time by
blending them or by following their motion.

pitch.description: Keep the sound's pitch, or let it follow the speed.

rate.description:
A constant rate from 0.05 to 100, or 0 to hold the first frame (a freeze). Ignored
when `curve` is given, and then 1.

reverse.description: Play the same source range backwards.

SpeedPoint.description: A point of a speed curve.

at.description: Where on the clip, from 0 (its start) to 1 (its end).

aspect.description: A square's width over its height, 0.1 to 10 (1 when omitted).

asset.description:
An `image` sprite's image asset (`asset_…`): its brightness is how much it covers,
tinted by the particle's colour, so light on black works best.

flip.description: Flips per second around the particle's own axis, so confetti tumbles, 0 to 10.

kind.description: The kind (a soft dot when omitted).

points.description: A star's points, 3 to 12 (4 when omitted).

softness.description: Edge softness from 0 (crisp) to 1 (a soft glow); 0.5 when omitted.

stretch.description: A spark's streak, as seconds of travel at its speed, 0 to 1 (0.05 when omitted).

oneOf.description: A round dot, crisp or soft.
A streak stretched along the direction of travel, bright at its head.
A star with thin points.
A ring.
A rectangle, such as a piece of confetti.
An image asset (`asset`).

width.description: Its width as a fraction of the font size (0.12 when omitted).

TextBox.description: A box behind each line of text, for captions and text clips.

padding.description: Space around the text as a fraction of the font size (0.25 when omitted).

radius.description: Corner radius as a fraction of the box height (0.3 when omitted).

oneOf.description: As written.
ALL CAPITALS.
all lower case.
The First Letter Of Every Word In Capitals, the rest lower case.

TextContent.description: Text content: the text, its style, restyled parts and how it appears.

reveal.description: How the text appears at the clip's start (and leaves at its end).

spans.description:
Parts of the text styled differently, by character positions; later spans win where
they overlap.

TextReveal.description: How a text appears: its letters, words or lines one after another.

duration.description: Time from the clip's start until the whole text is shown.

easing.description:
How each unit's motion runs; the motion's own easing when omitted (a cubic ease-out,
`back` for `pop` and `bounce` for `drop`).

exit.description: Also leave the same way, in reverse order, over the same time before the clip ends.

exit_motion.description: How units leave when `exit` is on; the arriving motion, reversed, when omitted.

order.description: The order units arrive in; leaving reverses it.

overlap.description:
How much each unit's motion overlaps the next one's, from 0 (one after another) to 1
(all together); 0.5 when omitted. `appear` ignores it.

TextSpan.description:
Part of a text styled differently. Positions count characters (Unicode scalar values)
of the written text from 0; `end` is not included.

end.description: The character after the last one.

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the canvas height.

TextStyle.description:
Text appearance. Lengths such as spacing, stroke and shadow are fractions of the font
size (em), so a style looks the same at every size.

box.description: Box behind each line (off when omitted).

case.description: Letter case shown; the text itself is kept as written.

font.description:
Font family: `Inter` (bundled) or a family of one of the project's font assets;
`Inter` when omitted.

glow.description: Soft light around the letters (off when omitted).

letter_spacing.description: Extra space between letters in em, from -0.5 to 2; 0 when omitted.

line_height.description:
Distance between lines as a multiple of the font size, from 0.5 to 4; 1.2 when
omitted.

shadow.description: Shadow under the letters (off when omitted).

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the canvas height.

stroke.description: Outline around the letters (off when omitted).

rate.description: Frame rate; edits snap to its frames.

Track.description: A track: clips ordered by start time that never overlap.

caption_style.description:
How the captions of a caption track look and move; defaults when omitted. Only
caption tracks have it.

clips.description: Clips sorted by start time, without overlaps.

oneOf.description: Video and image clips (their audio plays too).
Audio clips.
Text clips: titles.
Caption clips: pages of timed words, with the look in the track (ADR-0021).

Transform.description:
Placement of a clip on the canvas.

At identity the picture is fitted inside the canvas and centred.

anchor.description:
The pivot that rotation and scale turn around, as fractions of the picture's width
and height from its centre (`[-0.5, 0]` is the middle of its left edge). Moving it
does not move the picture.

flip_horizontal.description: Mirrors the picture left to right.

flip_vertical.description: Mirrors the picture top to bottom.

position.description:
Offset of the clip centre from the canvas centre, as fractions of canvas width
and height; x grows to the right, y grows downwards.

position_z.description: Depth as a fraction of the canvas width; positive is away from the viewer.

rotation_x.description:
Degrees the picture tilts around its horizontal axis; positive tips its top edge
away from the viewer.

rotation_y.description:
Degrees the picture turns around its vertical axis; positive turns its right edge
away from the viewer.

scale.description: Uniform scale relative to the fitted size (1 when omitted).

stretch.description:
Extra width and height factors on top of `scale`, for non-uniform scaling
(`[1, 1]` when omitted).

three_d.description:
Places the clip in the timeline's 3D scene (ADR-0037): it is seen through the
timeline's camera, sorted by depth with the 3D clips on the tracks next to it, and
blurred by the camera's depth of field. A 2D clip that turns in depth or moves in z
is seen through the default camera on its own.

Transition.description: A transition from a clip to the next one on its track.

duration.description: How long it lasts, centred on the cut.

params.description: Parameters that differ from their defaults.

type.description: The transition type, such as `dissolve` or `wipe`.

TranslationStyle.description:
How the translation line of bilingual captions looks: under the page, smaller, in the
caption's font, with its outline and box.

size.description: Size relative to the caption size, from 0.3 to 1 (0.7 when omitted).

box_color.description: Colour of a box behind the spoken word; none when omitted.

color.description: Colour that fills each word while it is spoken.

duration_ms.description: Length in milliseconds from the word's start.

fade_ms.description: Fade-in length of each word in milliseconds; 0 shows it at once.

format.description: Canvas size, frame rate and audio sample rate.

markers.description: Points to come back to, in time order.

tracks.description: Tracks from bottom to top: later tracks draw over earlier ones.
